status: Publish runner, protocol and selection before any new checkpoint or CT payload and before all model forwards.
question: Does native fine detail materially improve coherent public-control ink maps over exact matched degradation and the current coarse Hecate pipeline?

selection.provenance: Label-only lexicographic selection; at least95percent known labels and10to60percent ink among known labels, complete geometry support. The initial0814 label-only choice overlapped old calibration814-c03; it was replaced before CT access or outputs by the first otherwise eligible field excluding that calibration input plus one coarse-pixel guard. The pre-freeze amendment is not an outcome-directed replacement.
selection.scope: Previously published model-assisted annotations on previously used physical donors; these are development controls, not independent unseen specimens or independent photographic truth.

sampling.context_order: Eight by eight row-major grid;32coarse-pixel stride; score only each central32coarse or128fine pixels, with16coarse or64fine context pixels each side.
sampling.fine_regrid: Exact voxel-overlap box integration of the released uint8 source to isotropic2.4um, nearest-even rounded once. Source voxel i occupies[i-0.5,i+0.5]. Fine XY edges are crop+(4*coarse_origin+arange257)*2.4/source_pitch-0.5; Z edges31.5+(arange65-32)*2.4/source_pitch.
sampling.categorical_labels: Exact nearest source label cell at9.36um: floor((2*i+1)*20/39), with0unknown,1background,2ink. No new tracing, label selection by predictions, or target training.
sampling.support: All source interpolation footprints and geometry-mask footprints must exist. No missing-chunk fill, clipping to bounds or reflected external CT. The separate legacy model mask comes from any nonzero native-A voxel in each XY column. A/B share that mask; C uses its4x4XY max-pool. Metrics use the same pooled support for every arm.

arms.A_native_fine: Unchanged native-derived fine uint8 input through hecate2.4, divide200 with no clipping.
arms.B_degraded_fine: C is nearest-even round(mean of A over each exact4x4x4 block)); repeat each C voxel4times on all3axes and run the same fine model, same order, same precision and same A-derived mask, divide200 with no clipping.
arms.C_coarse: Run those exact C uint8 values through hecate9.6, divide255 with no clipping, using pooled A-derived validity.
arms.comparison_limit: A/B tests fixed-model degradation plus requantization. A/C changes checkpoint and input resolution. Fine checkpoint drops its two outer planes internally; equal nominal153.6um inputs do not imply equal effective depth apertures. A is rounded before averaging, so C is not byte-identical to the prior direct native-to9.6 averaging recipe.

pilot.purpose: Fix each model's depth order and a feasible fine CPU backend using only an already observed calibration context.
pilot.order_rule: For each model independently choose higher old-calibration central-core AUC; exact ties choose reverse. Reduce fine central128x128 probabilities by fixed4x4means onto central32x32 before scoring. This knowingly uses old calibration labels and cannot establish orientation or physical recto.
pilot.projection: Mean of two finefp32 pilot times times256 plus mean of two coarsefp32 times times128. If greater than3600, run the two fine pilot orders inCPUbf16.
pilot.bf16_acceptance: Both pilot orders must have maximum absolute full-patch probability difference<=0.005 and absolute common-grid coreAP difference<=0.01 relative to corresponding finefp32; the measured two-order mean bf16 forward time must also be strictly below the fp32 fine mean. Otherwise retainfp32. Preserve both measured means. No field output participates.
pilot.remaining_budget_rule: Stop resource-unassessable before field inference if the selected backend's projected full-field inference exceeds remaining whole-run time, checked before and after field acquisition.

metrics.common_grid: Area-average fineA/B central scores4x4 onto exactly the coarse grid; retain native fine score maps separately for inspection.
metrics.primary: Equally weighted mean of four quadrant ink recalls, each evaluated at its own descriptive5percentknown-background operating point. Background budget=floor(0.05*Nbackground); strict score>descending_background[budget] handles ties conservatively. This uses evaluation labels, is not a transported target threshold, and is not significance.
retained: Every field and every quadrant AP
Every field and every quadrant ROC AUC
Recall and actual background exceedance at the descriptive5percentpoint

gate.ceiling_or_missing_class: No promotion if any quadrant lacks a supported class, if coarse macro recall>0.95 leaves insufficient headroom, or if B has no misses. Retain the reason.
gate.interpretation: A fixed experiment-selection gate, not a statistical test or proof of letters. Inspect complete fixed-scale maps before any target extension. No unread-target extension is executed by this runner.

limits.limit_semantics: Whole-run wall time includes acquisition, loading, pilot and inference. A Unix alarm and between-forward checks stop work; native operations or outstanding HTTP calls can defer Python interruption. RSS is a between-forward soft stop, not an OS memory reservation. Body bytes are application reads, not wire traffic.

public_reporting: Public known-control aggregate results only after review. Detailed CT, labels, score arrays and local paths stay outsideGit. No candidate, prize or independently legible text claim follows from a numeric pass.
